title: Dicke States for Accelerated Two Two-Level Atoms
summary: We explore the formation of Dicke states. A system consisting of two two-level atoms located in the right Rindler wedge, has investigated to determine the conditions under which the superradiant or subradiant state can be formed. The dynamics of N two-level atoms forming symmetric state has also been analyzed and showed that the probability to excite any one atom of a collection of N atoms is related to the probability of exciting a single atom.
